model: Asset-Level Five-Lens Probability-Adjusted Economic Valuation Model

currentHeadReview.policy: Current state is established from repository-head evidence rather than README text alone. Economically relevant implementation, execution, validation, release, productization and transfer evidence can change a valuation; commit count and version labels cannot. Public website data intentionally excludes confidential implementation detail.
currentHeadReview.pricingPolicy: Seller asking price remains a separate acquisition position. Replacement cost, market/comparable proxy, income/licensing proxy and probability-adjusted strategic value remain analytical lenses and are not mechanically converted into the ask.

confidence.replacementCost: medium; seller-side reconstruction estimate rather than an independently audited all-in cost study
confidence.marketComparableProxy: low-to-medium by sector; primary transaction anchors exist but direct comparability is not established
confidence.incomeLicensingProxy: low; buyer-specific cash-flow and royalty evidence is not established
confidence.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: modelled with explicit maturity, commercialization, rights and time-risk assumptions

definitions.replacementCost: Seller-side estimate for recreating comparable present work product; supporting lens only.
definitions.marketComparableProxy: Modelled marketability indication using maturity, potential and sector context; not a verified precedent-transaction valuation.
definitions.incomeLicensingProxy: Modelled monetization indication; not a DCF or relief-from-royalty valuation.
definitions.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Replacement-cost anchored opportunity value adjusted for technical completion, commercialization probability, rights-transfer reserve, time/risk and sector context.
definitions.triangulatedEconomicReference: Weighted preliminary seller-side analytical reference combining the four valuation lenses; not certified market value.
definitions.sellerAsk: Indicative seller-side acquisition asking reference, separately underwritten from the analytical value model.
